validation_scope_limitations: No claim that translating C++ namespace functions into Go produces a type-checkable Go package. For example direct_shadow(left uint32) now spells left.target(left), which collides with the parameter in Go; parent target(left) already selected the unrelated +40 function. This is a P9 cross-language name-spelling follow-up, not a native-Go change; all native-Go captures seen are byte-identical.
Rust/Go per-function declarations encode enclosing namespaces in comments; no whole Rust-runtime or cross-language Go recompilation claim.
